tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF@e42a269 (module_esm_dump hooks in RRTMLWRAD and after RTRN inside SUBROUTINE RRTM of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver (rrtminit needs WRF's I/O layer for the k-distribution data), so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped RRTMLWRAD arguments of tile column 1 (p8w, pi3d, t3d, bottom-up) and the RRTM fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX at the model interfaces (RRTM levels 0..kte, already bottom-up). Expected values: dTdt against HTR(0..kte-1)/86400 (the RTRN heating of RRTM layers 1..kte, i.e. HTR(L-1) is layer L), dthdt against the wrapper's RTHRATEN increment, F_net and dz against the identities on the inputs, glw = TOTDFLUX(0), olr = TOTUFLUX(kte). Measured mismatch of this component against HTR over the four regimes is <= 2.4e-10 K/s in Linf (5e-6 of the column maximum of |dTdt|) and <= 5.3e-6 relative at the three largest-|dTdt| layers (real32 arithmetic of HEATFAC*(FNET(L-1)-FNET(L))/(PZ(L-1)-PZ(L)): differences of O(300 W/m^2) fluxes and O(1000 hPa) pressures carried in single precision), so the column assertions use Linf_error abs 1e-9 K/s (about 1e-5 of the column maximum) and the spot checks rel 1e-5, the real32 contract; the identities (F_net, dz, glw, olr, g_over_cp) use rel/abs 1e-9. The scheme is diagnostic (no time step), so no small-dt replay is involved. Regime: first radiation call (call 1, 19:00 UTC = 12:34 LST), clear sky (cldfra = 0, no condensate), tsk = 288.0 K, glw = 258.1 W/m^2, olr (model top) = 251.5 W/m^2; strongest cooling in the lowest layer and at layers 38-39 (the moist layer top).
